votes.motion: Issue a negative determination for the Shady Point shed and tree removal, with the condition that 12 trees be replanted over two years.
votes.quote: the motion passed on a split roll call vote with cl, jr, td and rb voting for the motion and bp, kj and cc voting against.

votes.motion: Issue a standard OOC to allow the work at 40 Fire Rd (two docks within the buffer zone) for Scott Benjamin.
votes.quote: a motion to issue a standard ooc to allow the work by cl with a second by jr.

votes.motion: Continue the 141 Hemlock Road Notice of Intent hearing to August 15, 2018 at 7 PM in the Billotta meeting room.
votes.quote: by a motion of bp and a second by kj. and the commission unanimously approved.

votes.motion: Continue the 564 Page Street Notice of Intent hearing to August 15, 2018 at 7 PM in the Billotta meeting room.
votes.quote: by a motion of bp and a second by kj and the commission unanimously approved.

votes.motion: Continue the Hickory Hills Association drawdown management plan hearing to August 15, 2018 at 7 PM at the Bilotta meeting room.
votes.quote: the motion was made by kj and seconded by td and the commission unanimously approved.

votes.motion: Approve the EO 255 Sunset Lane timeline: slopes corrected by August 11, 2018 and loaming and seeding by September 1, 2018.
votes.quote: september 1, 2018. this was approved by a motion of cl and a second of kj with a unanimous vote on the timeline.

votes.motion: Approve the timeline for the Battles to file a retroactive RDA for the work at 168 West Street.
votes.quote: retroactive rda for the work. this was approved by a motion of cl and a second of kj with a unanimous vote on the timeline.

votes.motion: Dismiss the Semerjian Notice of Non-compliance at Peninsula Drive.
votes.quote: the dismissal was approved by a motion of cl and a second of kj with a unanimous vote on the timeline.

votes.motion: Support the proposed Gilchrest land exchange (20 foot right of way for 2.3 acres into town ownership and 4.7 acres into a conservation restriction).
votes.quote: the commission voted unanimously to support this proposal by a motion of bp and a second by cc

votes.motion: Approve the certificate of compliance for 2 New West Townsend Road (DEP 208-1026).
votes.quote: new west townsend was approved by a motion of kj and second by cl

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of the June 27th meeting.
votes.quote: june 27th - approved by a motion of bp and a second by kj.
the meeting was adjourned at 10:30 pm by a motion of jk and a second by cc with a unanimous vote to approve
